name: Burn The Heretics boosts damage and healing against targets below 35% health (#708)
contract: Burn The Heretics 560857 is family 33, Attributes 448 (SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE) with EquippedItemClass -1 and no Stances, so it self-applies on learn. Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_DONE_VERSUS_AURASTATE (303) with EffectMiscValue 13 = AURA_STATE_HEALTHLESS_35_PERCENT and EffectBasePoints 9 + DieSides 1 = 10; effect 1 is the Ascension-only SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_HEALING_DONE_VERSUS_AURASTATE (360), same MiscValue 13, EffectBasePoints 9 + DieSides 1 = 10. Unit::Update calls ModifyAuraState(AURA_STATE_HEALTHLESS_35_PERCENT, HealthBelowPct(35)) every tick, so the state tracks health continuously; Unit::SpellPctDamageModsDone (called from SpellDamageBonusDone and MeleeDamageBonusDone) folds aura 303 into DoneTotalMod via victim->HasAuraState(AuraStateType(MiscValue)), and Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone folds aura 360 in the same way. Both are plain native aura types with no missing handler: this is not "no server-side implementation", it already works. The tooltip's second clause ("when Scorch Marks are consumed you now gain 10% increased Magic damage for 8 sec") is not represented anywhere in this spell's two effects, and no spell, aura or module code named 'Scorch Mark(s)' exists anywhere in this repository (module source, core source or SQL) for Sun Cleric or any other class, so that clause has no server mechanism to hook and is not exercised here. This scenario proves only the first, already-correct clause: a fixed base-1000 spell_damage_done/spell_healing_done query against Horusath Blast 500154 and Illumination 500143 (both family 33, no SPELL_ATTR6_IGNORE_CASTER_DAMAGE_MODIFIERS) is unaffected while the target's health is above 35% and gains exactly +10% once it drops below 35%, only for a caster who has learned 560857. The dummy fixture is critter template Dig Rat 3444 (creature_template.type 8), not a levelled mob: AscensionCompat's CanScaleCreature (AscensionCompat.cpp, AscensionCompatLevelScalingScript) excludes critters from local level scaling via IsCritter(), so this fixture keeps the health CoAGameplayTest asked for at summon. A levelled mob (e.g. entry 36, Harvest Golem, minlevel/maxlevel 11-12) does not: CreateTargets sets its level to 80 and its max health to the requested value, but OnAllCreatureUpdate then finds the live level (80) does not match the template-rolled 'original' level captured on spawn (11-12) and calls Creature::SelectLevel again within the first out-of-combat second, rebuilding max health from the template's own level-11-16 curve (as low as 349 HP, per the Chronomancer unmaker-of-realities scenario's own measurement of the same template) - far below the 60000/30000 this scenario's set_health steps require, which is exactly the 'Health fixture outside valid range' failure a levelled-mob dummy produces here. The below-35%-health assertions poll with a 2000ms within_ms budget because AURA_STATE_HEALTHLESS_35_PERCENT is not synchronous with set_health: Unit::Update (Unit.cpp) recomputes it once per Creature::Update call, and MapMgr::Update (MapMgr.cpp) only runs a continent map's non-player object pass (UpdateNonPlayerObjects, which is what ticks the dummy) on its own 'full' mapUpdateStep slot, gated by a 10ms MapUpdateInterval timer (MapMgr.cpp, worldserver.conf.dist) - other ticks call Map::Update with t_diff=0, which returns immediately after HandleDelayedVisibility (Map.cpp) without touching creatures at all. The harness's own module hook (CoAGameplayTest::OnUpdate) runs once per world tick regardless, so a set_health immediately followed by a zero-wait assert can land on ticks where the dummy's own Update never ran, reading a stale aura-state flag - this is not a server bug in the aurastate mod itself (SpellPctDamageModsDone/SpellHealingBonusDone's victim->HasAuraState(...) checks are correct and unconditional), it is this scenario's own steps racing the map's throttled full-update cadence.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Talent healing matches control above 35% health
Control's damage stays flat below 35% health
Talent gains exactly +10% damage below 35% health
Control's healing stays flat below 35% health
Talent gains exactly +10% healing below 35% health: 10% of the 800 healing baseline this fixture reads, not of the 1000 damage baseline
